title: Band Member 4 - The Drummer

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Yeah, well, ole Fauxter was never the best with PEOPLE. Or things, or places. He's basically the most incompetent, upsetting person I've ever met. Good front man for a band though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well, ole Fauxter was never the best with PEOPLE. Or things, or places. He's basically the most incompetent, upsetting person I've ever met. Good front man for a band though.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: It took me a long time to figure out I don't really fit in anywhere. And that's fine. I mean, if I DO fit in anywhere, it's with other people like me who don't really fit in either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It took me a long time to figure out I don't really fit in anywhere. And that's fine. I mean, if I DO fit in anywhere, it's with other people like me who don't really fit in either.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They came to boo you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They came to boo you?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: But... I do miss the drums. I loved to play. The rhythms really helped settle my mind when my brain had "the zoomies."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But... I do miss the drums. I loved to play. The rhythms really helped settle my mind when my brain had "the zoomies."

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Dammit... Alright. But just because it's you. And you seem decent... in a "pushy-but-pleasant" kind of way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dammit... Alright. But just because it's you. And you seem decent... in a "pushy-but-pleasant" kind of way.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: You really know how to tug on the ole heartstrings. Didn't take you for being so... I dunno, spiritual about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really know how to tug on the ole heartstrings. Didn't take you for being so... I dunno, spiritual about it.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Fine! I'll do it. But I don't want to hear anything more about Fauxter. I'm there cos I need an excuse to play drums. That's it. Now I gotta go. My old kit is in storage and I gotta hire a lifter droid to clear it out for me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine! I'll do it. But I don't want to hear anything more about Fauxter. I'm there cos I need an excuse to play drums. That's it. Now I gotta go. My old kit is in storage and I gotta hire a lifter droid to clear it out for me!

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Heya! You got some frown lines going on there. It's' frown-town on your brow. What's with all the frowning? You ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heya! You got some frown lines going on there. It's' frown-town on your brow. What's with all the frowning? You ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm good Lois.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm good Lois.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well, anything I can help you with?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, anything I can help you with?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Were you in a band?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Were you in a band?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: The band? So they need the old drum machine six thousand, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The band? So they need the old drum machine six thousand, huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: That's what Fauxter used to call me. How did he put it? "The woman with no emotions, but GREAT rhythm. Please welcome to the stage the most robotic musician in Nivalis - including the robots. Here is THE DRUM MACHINE SIX THOUSAND!"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what Fauxter used to call me. How did he put it? "The woman with no emotions, but GREAT rhythm. Please welcome to the stage the most robotic musician in Nivalis - including the robots. Here is THE DRUM MACHINE SIX THOUSAND!"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's pretty funny.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's pretty funny.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you won't rejoin the band?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you won't rejoin the band?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you won't rejoin the band?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you won't rejoin the band?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Look, playing drums in a failing funk-punk band was never exactly my scene, but in my early twenties, I was doing a lot of things that weren't really... me. You know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, playing drums in a failing funk-punk band was never exactly my scene, but in my early twenties, I was doing a lot of things that weren't really... me. You know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: So I tried things. Before I started developing games, I was into baking, handicrafts, cutting-edge sneakers, murderball, knitting, nuclear isotopes...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I tried things. Before I started developing games, I was into baking, handicrafts, cutting-edge sneakers, murderball, knitting, nuclear isotopes...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: But I didn't really care about any of those things. I was just trying to find a place where people accepted me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I didn't really care about any of those things. I was just trying to find a place where people accepted me.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Maybe? But I didn't feel it. And I certainly didn't feel like I was "accepted" when I was on stage in front of seven fans, and five were booing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe? But I didn't feel it. And I certainly didn't feel like I was "accepted" when I was on stage in front of seven fans, and five were booing.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: They were very committed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They were very committed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did they?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did they?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It could.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It could.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've been better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just so very busy...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just so very busy...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fauxter asked me to talk to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fauxter asked me to talk to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fauxter asked me to talk to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fauxter asked me to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We're putting the band back together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're putting the band back together.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We're putting the band back together.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We're putting the band back together.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That seems a bit insensitive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems a bit insensitive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Trust FAUXTER?! I wouldn't trust him as far as I could throw my drum kit. But... dammit, if I don't miss playing music with people... even if those people are that FUCKING band again...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trust FAUXTER?! I wouldn't trust him as far as I could throw my drum kit. But... dammit, if I don't miss playing music with people... even if those people are that FUCKING band again...

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I dunno though... How can I be sure Fauxter won't fuck it all up again? Say I agree to play drums - just a few gigs for fun - what would I get out of it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno though... How can I be sure Fauxter won't fuck it all up again? Say I agree to play drums - just a few gigs for fun - what would I get out of it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You just have to trust me. It will be worthwhile.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You just have to trust me. It will be worthwhile.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You just have to trust me. It will be worthwhile.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You just have to trust me. It will be worthwhile.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You just have to trust him. He really wants to make it work this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You just have to trust him. He really wants to make it work this time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You just have to trust him. He really wants to make it work this time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You just have to trust him. He really wants to make it work this time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Trust your instincts. You want to play drums again. No matter who you play with, the MUSIC is what's important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trust your instincts. You want to play drums again. No matter who you play with, the MUSIC is what's important.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Trust your instincts. You want to play drums again. No matter who you play with, the MUSIC is what's important.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Trust your instincts. You want to play drums again. No matter who you play with, the MUSIC is what's important.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Still in that self-finding phase?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still in that self-finding phase?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess they didn't?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess they didn't?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: And, well, I'm working on a game with rhythm action elements. Maybe drumming again would help? You know? As research.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And, well, I'm working on a game with rhythm action elements. Maybe drumming again would help? You know? As research.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're in?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're in?
